例句

  1. I’ve finished reading the novel I borrowed from the library yesterday, so now I have nothing to do.
    我昨天跟圖書館借的小說已經看完了，所以現在沒事可做。
  2. I've just finished my homework.
    我剛寫完功課。
  3. Has your sister found a new job yet?
    你姊姊找到新工作了嗎？
  4. I've already paid for dinner.
    晚餐的錢我已經付了。
  5. My father has gone to work.
    我爸爸已經去上班了。
  6. We have cleaned the classroom, so we can go home now.
    我們打掃完教室了，所以現在可以回家了。
  7. She has lost her key, so she can't get into the house.
    她把鑰匙弄丟了，所以她進不了家門。
  8. Have you finished writing the letter?
    你寫完那封信了嗎？
  9. She finished cleaning the kitchen at nine.
    她九點把廚房打掃完。
  10. Please finish eating before the bell rings.
    請在鐘響之前吃完。
  11. When you finish using the computer, please turn it off.
    電腦用完請關機。
  12. Tom hasn't finished painting his room yet.
    Tom 還沒有把他的房間漆完。
  13. I'm hungry. Is there anything to eat?
    我餓了。有什麼可以吃的嗎？
  14. I have something to tell you.
    我有事要跟你說。
  15. There is nothing to worry about.
    沒有什麼好擔心的。
  16. Would you like something to drink?
    你想喝點東西嗎？
  17. My grandmother always gives us something to take home.
    我奶奶總是給我們一些東西帶回家。
  18. It was raining, and we had nothing to do all day.
    那天在下雨，我們一整天都沒事做。
  19. I've finished cleaning my room, so now I can watch TV.
    我把房間打掃完了，所以現在可以看電視了。
  20. Have you finished reading the book I lent you?
    你看完我借你的書了嗎？
  21. My brother has finished doing his homework, so he has nothing to do now.
    我弟弟寫完功課了，所以他現在沒事做。
  22. I've already finished packing for the trip.
    我已經把旅行的行李打包好了。
  23. There was nothing to see in the old museum.
    那間舊博物館裡沒什麼好看的。
  24. Do you have anything to read on the train?
    你有什麼可以在火車上看的東西嗎？
  25. She has just finished talking on the phone.
    她剛講完電話。
  26. I have nothing to wear to the party.
    我沒有衣服可以穿去派對。
  27. We've finished eating, so let's go for a walk.
    我們吃完了，所以去散個步吧。
  28. Tom has nothing to say about the game.
    Tom 對那場比賽沒有什麼話要說。
  29. I haven't finished watching the movie yet, so don't tell me the end.
    我還沒看完那部電影，所以不要告訴我結局。
  30. I've returned the books to the library, so I need something new to read.
    我把書還給圖書館了，所以得找新的東西來看。
  31. The novel I'm reading now is very long.
    我現在在看的小說很長。
  32. I returned the umbrella I borrowed last week.
    我把上星期借的傘還回去了。
